inheritancePolicy.commonContent: Shared mechanical, diesel-generator, fuel, oil, cooling, pneumatic, running-gear and auxiliary content may be inherited only where applicability is explicitly confirmed for the selected profile/execution.
inheritancePolicy.variantOverrides: Cab/body layout, control equipment, electrical circuits and any execution-specific apparatus live in the variant layer when they differ.
inheritancePolicy.actualEquipmentWins: Actual installed equipment and documented modernization override assumptions based only on series or locomotive number for information routing.
inheritancePolicy.unknownExecution: Variant-dependent operational actions fail closed until the actual execution is confirmed.
inheritancePolicy.noAdjacentVariantLeak: TEM2UM, TEM2T, TEM2A and later TEM-family equipment is excluded unless a future dedicated profile explicitly adds it with evidence.

integrationBoundary.rule: The TEM2/TEM2U knowledge foundation is complete and cross-layer validated. Android assets/repositories/screens, production AssistantEngine/AssistantIndex wiring and application navigation remain a separate integration stage. Unknown or contradictory actual execution stays FAIL_CLOSED.

profileDimensions.rule: Do not infer diesel execution from series alone; factory period and later replacement/modernization must be considered.
Brake apparatus identity and routing require actual-equipment confirmation before variant-dependent instructions.

familyRules: Series name selects an information profile but never proves the exact installed equipment after overhaul or modernization.
TEM2U may inherit TEM2-family common content only where applicability is independently confirmed.
TEM2 electrical topology must not be assumed identical to TEM2U when the TEM2U manufacturer manual defines a dedicated circuit/execution.
Unknown execution blocks variant-dependent operational actions and forces clarification or safe generic guidance.
No TEM2UM, TEM2T or TEM2A feature enters TEM2/TEM2U profiles without a dedicated evidence-backed profile or explicit modernization record.

profileRules.electricalSchemePolicy: Use TEM2-specific evidence and revision-aware circuit data; do not substitute TEM2U or TEM2UM diagrams merely because the family is related.
profileRules.dieselPolicy: PD1/PD1M execution is not inferred from the series label alone; actual build/installed equipment evidence wins.
profileRules.modernizationPolicy: Actual installed equipment overrides factory-number assumptions for information routing, but not action authority.
profileRules.unknownExecutionPolicy: Fail closed for variant-dependent operational actions.

profileRules.electricalSchemePolicy: Use the dedicated TEM2U electrical layer from TEM2U-specific evidence; TEM2 and TEM2UM diagrams are not interchangeable defaults.
profileRules.controlPolicy: One-person-control and additional-station content is exposed only when the actual locomotive retains the documented equipment.
profileRules.brakePolicy: Manufacturer baseline apparatus names are reference defaults only; actual installed apparatus must be confirmed before variant-dependent guidance.
profileRules.modernizationPolicy: Actual installed equipment overrides assumptions from series/number for information routing, but does not grant authority for actions without current source support.
profileRules.unknownExecutionPolicy: Fail closed for variant-dependent operational actions.
